name: moyu
description: A focused Electron desktop shell for a trusted creative workspace.
author: moyu contributors

scripts.build:win: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
scripts.build:win:x64: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.build:mac:arm64: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:x64: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
